expectations.text: Uses reveal.js as the presentation framework
expectations.evidence: No reveal.js reference found. The presentation uses a custom HTML/CSS/JS implementation with manual slide navigation (div.slide elements, custom showSlide/changeSlide functions).

expectations.text: Contains a timeline with at least 3 historical dates/years
expectations.evidence: Slide 4 contains a visual timeline component with 6 dates: 1809, 1842, 1866, 1909, 1919, 1921. Uses dedicated CSS classes (timeline-slide, timeline-container, timeline-line, timeline-event, event-dot, event-year).

expectations.text: Has at least one discussion slide prompting student discussion
expectations.evidence: Slide 8 (id='slide-8') is a dedicated discussion slide with class 'discussion-slide', titled 'Diskussion i par (3-4 minuter)' containing 3 discussion questions and the instruction 'Diskutera med din bänkkamrat. Var beredda att dela en tanke med klassen.'

expectations.text: Contains a source criticism exercise with a historical quote
expectations.evidence: Slide 9 (id='slide-9') contains a quote box with the historical quote 'Att ge rösträtt åt den stora massan...' attributed to 'Ur ett konservativt debattinlägg i Första kammaren, ca 1890-talet', followed by 4 source-critical analysis questions (Vem, Varför, Tendens, Relevans idag).

expectations.text: No slide has more than 3 bullet points in a list
expectations.evidence: Multiple slides exceed 3 bullet points per list. Slide 2 left column: 4 <li>. Slide 5 left column: 4 <li>. Slide 5 right column: 4 <li>. Slide 6: 6 <li>. Slide 7 left column: 4 <li>. Slide 9 source-questions: 4 <li>. Slide 10 left column: 4 <li>. Slide 10 right column: 4 <li>.

expectations.text: At least half of slide titles are phrased as questions
expectations.evidence: Only 1 out of 10 h2 titles ends with '?': 'Vad menar vi med demokrati?' (10%). The other 9 are statements: 'Ståndsriksdagen (1435-1866)', 'Tidslinje: Vägen till demokrati', 'Riksdagsreformen 1866', 'Kampen för rösträtt', 'Genombrottet: 1919-1921', 'Diskussion i par (3-4 minuter)', 'Källkritisk övning', 'Källkritiska begrepp att använda', 'Sammanfattning'.

expectations.text: Uses reveal.js fragments for progressive disclosure
expectations.evidence: No elements with class='fragment' found anywhere in the HTML. The presentation has no progressive disclosure mechanism.

expectations.text: Speaker notes present on at least half of content slides
expectations.evidence: No <aside class='notes'> elements found in the HTML. Zero speaker notes across all 11 slides.

expectations.text: Single HTML file with no local file dependencies
expectations.evidence: All CSS is embedded in a <style> block, all JavaScript is inline in a <script> block. No external stylesheets, scripts, images, or fonts are referenced. The file is fully self-contained.

expectations.text: Base font size is at least 24px for projector readability
expectations.evidence: No explicit px-based font-size is set on body or a .reveal container. Body has no font-size declaration. All font sizes use viewport-relative units (vw): content text at 1.8vw (about 19px on a 1080p screen), headings at 3.2vw. The requirement for a base font-size of at least 24px is not met.
